premises.text: High relapse rates are driven by lack of communication and lack of accountability for recovery activities
premises.evidence_span: address the two key things that cause relapse. One, lack of communication, and two, lack of accountability for your recovery activities

premises.text: Mobile platform integrated with wearables tracks geolocation and accelerometer engagement for recovery-plan activities
premises.evidence_span: Those activities that have a geolocation are tracked by geolocation and also accelerometer

premises.text: Shared support-network dashboards, missed-program alerts, and an isolation SOS keep people connected
premises.evidence_span: You can simply press this button, and it sends everybody in your support network on the application a message to reach out to you

premises.text: Non-triggering rewards such as fitness, yoga, and coffee coupons reinforce active recovery
premises.evidence_span: we provide rewards that don't trigger your technology addiction, but you accrue points to get rewards such as fitness classes, yoga classes, and free coffee coupons

premises.text: First sales channel is inpatient treatment centers, then healthcare providers, insurers, and EAPs
premises.evidence_span: our target addressable market for our first sales channel, which is inpatient treatment centers

premises.text: Platform data helps treatment centers with referrals and outcome studies
premises.evidence_span: data that we also provide to the treatment centers, which are helpful for them for referrals, outcome studies, and other data
